import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read the provided CSV
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/weather.csv')

# Calculate mean temperature by city, then round to the nearest 5 degrees
means = df.groupby('city')['temp_c'].mean()
rounded = (means / 5).round() * 5

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 4))
ax.bar(rounded.index, rounded.values)
ax.set_xlabel('City')
ax.set_ylabel('Average temperature (°C), rounded to nearest 5°')
ax.set_title('Average Temperature by City')
ax.set_ylim(bottom=0, top=max(rounded.values) * 1.15)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
